_notes: Filenames are generic Layer_0..Layer_5 with no semantic content, so classification was done by visually inspecting each layer's isolated geometry. Layer_0 is a long rectangular box matching the CubeSat chassis (bus). Layer_1 is an extremely thin, long wire-like element consistent with a deployable whip/dipole antenna. Layer_3 and Layer_5 both show a clear repeating photovoltaic-cell grid pattern (solar panel). Layer_2 and Layer_4 are flat panels of matching size/shape but show only a diagonal structural brace pattern with no cell grid, so they were left Unknown rather than guessed as solar panels.
